h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Khora, Ghaziabad

items.pText: Khora, on the Ghaziabad side of the Noida border, is one of the most densely built areas in the National Capital Region. Open ground is scarce, so a play area here usually has to fit into a school courtyard, a society corner or a small park. FunPlay Systems designs equipment that works in such spaces and supplies it from our factory in Vasai, about 1,120 km away.

We have been manufacturing outdoor playground equipment since 2002. For Khora and the rest of Ghaziabad we send the equipment by road and install it with our own team or a dealer in north India. You share the plot size and a few photos, and we reply with a layout drawing that shows how much safe play area each piece needs.

richText.heading: Making the most of a small plot

c: On a small plot, one combined play station often works better than several separate pieces, because it shares a single safe zone. A unit with a slide, a climbing wall and a deck can keep a group of children busy in a space where two swings would barely fit. Our
Play Lands
and themed play stations come in several sizes.

Where the space is a long strip, a row of spring riders and a see-saw can work. Keep the equipment away from boundary walls and gates, and mark the safe area clearly so parked bikes do not creep into it.

richText.heading: Heat, dust and cold in the NCR

c: Ghaziabad summers are very hot and dusty, and winter mornings can be cold and foggy. Plastic slides in direct sun get hot by afternoon, so place them facing away from the west or plan a shade sail. Roto-moulded parts keep their colour well, and we offer more than 15 shades.

Dust settles on everything here. A wash with plain water once a week keeps slides smooth and stops grit wearing the surfaces. During the July to September rains, check that water drains away from the posts.

Most buyers in Khora are private schools that need equipment for nursery and primary children, and housing societies that want a safe corner for younger residents. Small parks and community spaces also call us.

items.q: Do you install playground equipment in Khora, Ghaziabad?
items.a: Yes. We make the equipment at our Vasai factory and send it by road. Our installation team or a dealer in north India installs it on your site. Tell us about lane width and gate size, since that decides how the larger parts are carried in.

items.q: What equipment fits a very small school courtyard?
items.a: A compact multi play station or two or three individual pieces such as spring riders and a small slide. Send us the length and width and we will suggest options with the safe area marked.

items.q: Will plastic slides get too hot in the Ghaziabad summer?
items.a: Any surface in direct afternoon sun gets hot. Face slides away from the west where possible, or add shade, and the equipment stays usable through most of the day. Lighter colours also stay cooler than dark ones.

items.q: How do we keep the equipment clean in a dusty area?
items.a: Wash it with plain water regularly and check bolts every few months. We share simple maintenance steps at handover, and our after sales team can help if a part needs attention.
